rules.description: Verify each input table generates at least one active StatVar.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs FROM stats

rules.description: Verify all 2016 demographic, education, and immunization StatVars have MaxDate >= 2016.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('GrowthRate_Count_Person', 'Count_Student_EnrolledInSchool_PrimaryEducation', 'Count_Student_EnrolledInSchool_SecondaryEducation', 'Count_Person_Female', 'Count_Person_Male', 'Count_Person_ResidesInGroupQuarters', 'Count_Person_ResidesInHousehold', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_Hospital', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PartialHospitalizationProgram', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_HealthCenter', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PrivatelyOwnedNotForProfitEstablishment', 'Count_Person_VaccineAdministered_OralPolioVaccine3_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person', 'Count_BirthEvent_HealthFacility', 'Count_HealthEstablishment', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_GovernmentOwnedEstablishment_HealthFacility', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_NonGovernmentalOrganizationEstablishment', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PrivatelyOwnedEstablishment_HealthFacility') AND NOT (StatVar IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Rural', 'Count_Person_Urban') AND CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) >= '1980')

rules.description: Verify 2014 district census StatVars and 2015 school enrollment StatVars have MaxDate >= 2014.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_Student_EnrolledInSchool_PrimaryEducation', 'Count_Student_EnrolledInSchool_SecondaryEducation', 'Count_Person_Female', 'Count_Person_Male', 'Count_Person_ResidesInGroupQuarters', 'Count_Person_ResidesInHousehold', 'Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Rural', 'Count_Person_Urban')

rules.description: Verify historical census growth rate (2002) and discontinued health facility series (2006-2013) meet their expected end-year boundaries.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('GrowthRate_Count_Person', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_Hospital', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PartialHospitalizationProgram', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_HealthCenter', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PrivatelyOwnedNotForProfitEstablishment', 'Count_Person_VaccineAdministered_OralPolioVaccine3_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person', 'Count_BirthEvent_HealthFacility', 'Count_HealthEstablishment', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_GovernmentOwnedEstablishment_HealthFacility', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_NonGovernmentalOrganizationEstablishment', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_PrivatelyOwnedEstablishment_HealthFacility')
